subject: social-studies
title: The Globalisation Supply Chain of One Smartphone Exit Ticket

questions.prompt: A student says A global product is made entirely in the country where it is sold, because every stage of making it happens in one place. What is the best correction?

choices.text: The student is right - one brand and one shop mean the product was made in one place

A global product crosses borders at every stage: raw materials are mined in one country, components are made in a second, the product is assembled in a third, and only then is it shipped to the shop shelf in Singapore - value is added at every handover along the chain.
The chain ran the other way: Singapore made the phone first and the stages spread backwards to the mine
Value never rose; the price was fixed at the mine

questions.misconception: A global product is made entirely in the country where it is sold, because every stage of making it happens in one place.
questions.feedback: If you agreed with the student, that is the trap: A global product is made entirely in the country where it is sold, because every stage of making it happens in one place. Reteach point: A global product crosses borders at every stage: raw materials are mined in one country, components are made in a second, the product is assembled in a third, and only then is it shipped to the shop shelf in Singapore - value is added at every handover along the chain.

questions.prompt: In one sentence, explain what a route arrow does in the chain.
questions.answer: It carries the product - raw materials, then components, then the finished phone - across a border into the next country, where the next stage adds more value.
questions.feedback: A strong answer names the carried product and its effect: a new stage in a new country, value up.

questions.prompt: What is the value of the phone after assembly in Country C?
questions.feedback: Scene 3 is careful with the numbers: assembly lifts the value from $35 to $70; $120 comes only after the Singapore sale.

questions.prompt: In one sentence, state the last stage of the chain and what carried the chain to it.
questions.answer: The phone is sold in Singapore at $120 of value, carried there by the mining in Country A ($10), the components made in Country B ($35) and the assembly in Country C ($70), which added value stage by stage.
questions.feedback: A strong answer gives the full chain in order - Country A $10, Country B $35, Country C $70 - and ends with Singapore $120.
